The following events took place in '''14 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]]'''.

==Events==
*[[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] and [[Iella Wessiri Antilles|Iella Wessiri]] married.
*Final [[Confrontation on Crseih Station|defeat]] of the [[Empire Reborn]],<ref name="TCS">''[[The Crystal Star]]''</ref> leaving only the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]]<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>
*[[Yavin 4 Incursion|Rise]] and [[Battle of Korriban (Disciples of Ragnos crisis)|fall]] of the [[Disciples of Ragnos]] and the beginning and end of the short lived [[Disciples of Ragnos crisis|crisis]].<ref name="JKA" />
*[[Kyle Katarn]] took on [[Jaden Korr]] and [[Rosh Penin]] as apprentices.<ref name="JKA" />
*[[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]] took on [[Raltharan]] as an apprentice.<ref name="JKA" />
*[[Blenjeel]] was added to the [[New Republic Galactic Database]].<ref name="JKA" />
*[[Slavery/Legends|Slavery]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] suffered a major blow.<ref name="TCS" />
*[[Keeramak]] came to power on [[Lwhekk/Legends|Lwhekk]].<ref name="FHII:R">''[[The New Jedi Order: Force Heretic II: Refugee]]''</ref>
*[[Grand Coruscant Theatre]] presented the [[Hyperdrive Tour]] with [[Theepa]] in [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].<ref name="JKA" />
*[[Rosh Penin]] turned to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] as [[Tavion Axmis]]'s apprentice, then returned to the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light]].<ref name="JKA" />
*[[Jaden Korr]] was promoted to [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]].<ref name="JKA" />
